all_feed.description: Every consecutive pair of collected last-traded-price observations for an in-scope market whose absolute change is greater than or equal to swing_threshold_dollars, in either direction.

high_roi.description: PLACEHOLDER. The owner's 'high ROI' model was not supplied. Until it is, this filter uses the rule below, which is a mechanical screen and NOT a prediction or recommendation. Replace this block when the owner's model is available (see Flagged for Review, F-14).
high_roi.implied_return_formula: (1 - p) / p, where p is the post-move last price. Arithmetic only: the return if a YES contract bought at p settles YES, before fees.

sources.price_observations: data/live/price_history.json (written by scripts/collect.py from GET /markets last_price_dollars)
